method: Alternating fresh Node processes; sampling off; fixed exported inputs; median of per-run means; not browser FPS

conditions.note: CPU throughput, not interactive FPS. Compare like-for-like unprofiled runs; sampling has overhead.

notes: wall clock timings, excluded from the observation digest
a debug build measures debug costs; compare like with like
median, p95, and frames-over-budget use the most recent bounded sample window (up to 1024 frames)

window.semantics: VM-safe-point sample counts, not exact function milliseconds or call counts. Native calls and GC are not asynchronously sampled. Short functions, inlining and safe-point placement can bias attribution; compare with sampling disabled.
